raw: {"commentary": "August revenue of [[revenue.month.actual]] came in above budget by [[revenue.month.vs_budget]] ([[revenue.month.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[revenue.month.vs_py]] ([[revenue.month.vs_py_pct]]), though gross profit of [[gross_profit.month.actual]] was below budget by [[gross_profit.month.vs_budget]] ([[gross_profit.month.vs_budget_pct]]) as direct costs of [[direct_costs.month.actual]] ran above budget by [[direct_costs.month.vs_budget]] ([[direct_costs.month.vs_budget_pct]]), leaving gross margin at [[gross_margin.month.actual]], below budget by [[gross_margin.month.vs_budget_pp]] and down on last year by [[gross_margin.month.vs_py_pp]]. Operating profit for August of [[operating_profit.month.actual]] was below budget by [[operating_profit.month.vs_budget]] ([[operating_profit.month.vs_budget_pct]]) and slightly down on last year by [[operating_profit.month.vs_py]] ([[operating_profit.month.vs_py_pct]]). Year to date, revenue of [[revenue.ytd.actual]] is above budget by [[revenue.ytd.vs_budget]] ([[revenue.ytd.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[revenue.ytd.vs_py]] ([[revenue.ytd.vs_py_pct]]), with operating profit of [[operating_profit.ytd.actual]] above budget by [[operating_profit.ytd.vs_budget]] ([[operating_profit.ytd.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[operating_profit.ytd.vs_py]] ([[operating_profit.ytd.vs_py_pct]]). On clients, Orchard Lane Foods contributed [[client.orchard-lane.revenue.month.actual]] in August, [[client.orchard-lane.share.month.actual]] of agency revenue, above its May to July average by [[client.orchard-lane.revenue.month.vs_avg3m]] ([[client.orchard-lane.revenue.month.vs_avg3m_pct]]), while Kestrel Mobility and Brightwater Housing also each ran above their May to July averages, by [[client.kestrel.revenue.month.vs_avg3m]] ([[client.kestrel.revenue.month.vs_avg3m_pct]]) and [[client.brightwater.revenue.month.vs_avg3m]] ([[client.brightwater.revenue.month.vs_avg3m_pct]]) respectively. By contrast, Marlow & Finch billed [[client.marlow-finch.revenue.month.actual]] in August, below its May to July average by [[client.marlow-finch.revenue.month.vs_avg3m]] ([[client.marlow-finch.revenue.month.vs_avg3m_pct]]), and its share of year-to-date agency revenue at [[client.marlow-finch.share.ytd.actual]] is worth flagging to the owner."}
